titleText: JTF News: Irish Times, BBC News
mainText: EasyJet agreed to a £5.7 billion acquisition by a US firm.
The Senate Homeland Security Committee voted to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress.
Israel charges a settler with killing Palestinian activist Awdah Hathaleen in the occupied West Bank.
France is implementing a ban on unsolicited telemarketing calls starting next week.
Germany arrested a Ukrainian national suspected of espionage against an arms firm.
